output.summary: Genus of evergreen trees native to northeastern New South Wales and central and southeastern Queensland, Australia. Its round fruits have exceptionally tough woody shells; only M. integrifolia and M. tetraphylla are commercially grown for edible nuts, while the other two species contain cyanogenic glycosides.
output.edibilityNote: M. integrifolia and M. tetraphylla nuts are cultivated for human food; M. jansenii and M. ternifolia nuts contain cyanogenic glycosides.
